headline: Parking requests at 27 Coburn St., 83 Medford St., 21 Wyeth St., and 122 Belmont St.; Broadway and Taylor crossing safety.
summary: Requests include a no parking request, handicap parking requests and a relocation, and a crossing safety request at Broadway and Taylor. Also on the list are a bus stop location at Centre St. and Main St., a Northern Strand Community Trail Master Plan presentation, and an update on ongoing transportation projects.
